correctness.rationale: Internal consecutive 1 gaps are the only constraints on finite words: use arbitrarily long allowed gaps to accommodate initial and terminal zeros, then extend with allowed gaps. A forbidden distance d first appears as a word of length d+1, so the length-n cover has the exact set D_n=(D∩[1,n−1])∪[n,∞). At the renewal root q_E for either gap set, the distribution q_E^d on allowed distances has finite mean. The suspended iid process attains entropy −log q_E. Conversely, Kac and Abramov reduce an ergodic positive-marker process to its stationary gap process; the single-gap entropy bound and relative entropy against q_E^d force iid gaps of that law at equality. Zero marker frequency gives the all-zero atom. Ergodic decomposition gives uniqueness without a gcd-one assumption. In log coordinates u=−log q, δ=u_n−u, the exact added tail is e^(−nu)H_r(e^(−u)). Its first derivative is O_D(nq^n) and all second derivatives of the total renewal sum are uniformly bounded on a positive-u neighborhood. The root change is O_D(q^n) by the mean-value theorem, yielding δ=q^nH_r(q)/M+O_D(nq^(2n)). Evaluating the length moment at the shifted root adds n q^n H_r(q)+q^(n+1)H'_r(q)−Jδ+O_D(n²q^(2n)), with J=Σ d²q^d: the perturbation derivative is O_D(n²q^n) on the root interval. Inverting M_n proves the stated signed bias and O_D(q^n) remainder. The finitely many H_r(q)>0 give eventual sign, ratio 1/M and exactly the finite cluster set. For the even shift, 1−q²=q and M=√5, so H_even(q)=1/q and H_odd(q)=1, with exactly the two claimed coefficients.
residual_risks: When extending finite words with boundary zeros, the boundary gaps must be chosen long enough; an arbitrary fixed allowed distance suffices only after they are accommodated. Unbounded allowed distances resolve this.

value.rationale: The equilibrium one-cylinder marginal is a natural test of approximation by finite memory. The exact signed leading term quantifies a real separation from entropy convergence: the marker deficit is asymptotically n/M times the entropy excess. The all-allowed versus forbidden residue tail combinations change measurable coefficients, already in the classical even shift with two different constants. This supplies a concrete benchmark for quantitative measure approximation, not a claim for all observables.
residual_risks: Quantification is for mixed eventually periodic gap sets and the marker marginal only; it does not establish a sharp whole-measure metric.
